cues.text: A new Instagram enquiry lands just before midnight, long after the office closed.
A distribution rule matches it and hands the lead to a named agent.
The lead shows up in her own list, not in a group chat.
By morning her day already starts with the call that waited longest.
No lead is lost to the night, and the pipeline shows 7.23 crore.
Speed to lead, every hour. See EstateCRM.
